name: VIP Laser Coaching Call
description: An intimate, high-level group Zoom where you get direct feedback on your biggest challenge. Only action-takers allowed. You bring the question. We bring the clarity.
howToEarn: Hybrid model: needs Sage tier AND 750 pts to spend. Tight cap (5/month) creates scarcity and protects Danno's time. Big perceived value for relatively low delivery cost — great early-funnel reward.

name: 1-on-1 Funnel Makeover Call
description: Get a live funnel makeover. We look at what's there, what's missing, and what to fix first. Real-time recommendations to boost conversions, lead flow, and retention.
howToEarn: Higher-touch reward. Keep at 3/month — funnel reviews require focused energy. Gates by behavior trigger (completed OK trials) so the call isn't wasted on people without an offer to show.

name: Offer + Messaging Alignment Session
description: 30-minute high-impact session. We tighten your offer, uncover the core transformation, and build positioning that pulls. You leave with words you can actually use.
howToEarn: Lower-tier entry reward. Philosopher unlock makes this attainable early but still earned. 30-min cap protects Danno's time. Strong intro to the kind of help paid offers deliver.

name: Copy Review & Optimization
description: Submit one landing page or sales page. We review it, mark it up, and send back specific recommendations to improve clarity and conversion.
howToEarn: Pure points-to-spend. Asynchronous delivery (can be done by team) so cap is higher. Good 'use your points' option for members who don't want to wait for a call slot.

name: Custom Chatbot Strategy Blueprint
description: A personalized flow map and strategy built specifically for your business. We map exactly what your chatbot should do, when, and why — then hand it to you with next steps to deploy.
howToEarn: Pure behavior trigger. Hitting 50 leads proves they're using the chatbot — perfect moment to give them a strategy upgrade. The reward feeds the chatbot lever even more, which feeds revenue. Smart loop.

name: 90-Day Strategy Sprint Call
description: A forward-focused call to map out the next 90 days of your marketing, offer, and client acquisition. You leave with a real plan, not theory.
howToEarn: Mid-tier strategic call. Hybrid: requires Sage AND 1,000 pts. Cap at 5/month — these are 60-min calls. Use to keep mid-tier members engaged while they earn toward Sentinel.

name: Digital Elite Performer Badge
description: Awarded only to those who hit specific performance and commitment milestones. Use it in email signatures, on websites, and proudly wear it inside your own community. Proof you're not just talking the talk.
howToEarn: Pure tier-unlock recognition reward. Cheap to deliver (digital asset), high perceived value (status). The 'Elite Performer' badge IS the reward — something to display, brag about, build identity around. Reinforces the 'earn your way' philosophy.

name: Limited Edition Evolve Omega Swag Box
description: Premium notebook, mug, shirt, and a handwritten card from Danno. Feels personal, exclusive, and memorable. Reserved for those who've earned their way to Sentinel.
howToEarn: Physical reward at Sentinel reinforces the conversion moment. Shipping = real cost (~$75 with packaging + shipping). Handwritten card from Danno makes it personal. Strong emotional pre-conversion moment for Academy invite. Cap at lifetime to avoid repeat costs.

name: Live Feature Inside the Community
description: Position yourself as a thought leader. Build trust with the community by going live with Danno in a 1-on-1 spotlight interview. Your story. Your wins. Real visibility.
howToEarn: Spotlight reward. Curated, not auto-claimed — Danno picks who to feature based on story, win, or fit. 2/month cap. Member gets exposure + content; Danno gets compelling case studies for the group. Win-win.

name: 30 Days Access to Evolve Omega Academy
description: 30 days inside our Academy. Full access to core systems, trainings, and community. Perfect for deep implementation and building real momentum. Use it well — it's a window, not a permanent door.
howToEarn: 30-day Academy trial. Zero hard cost (digital access). Massive perceived value ($833 = 1/12 of $10K Academy). This is the pre-conversion test drive — if they use the trial well, the 12-month upgrade conversation is easy. 10 spots/quarter prevents abuse.

name: 30 Days Access to Evolve Omega Elite
description: 30 days inside Evolve Omega Elite. High-level conversations, advanced strategy sessions, and powerful accountability reserved for our most committed students.
howToEarn: 30-day Elite trial — the bridge to Accelerator. Centurion-tier members are already action-takers. Trial month should produce real results, leading to natural upgrade conversation. 5 spots/quarter.

name: Evolve Omega Lux Partnership Conversation
description: A real conversation about partnering with Danno inside the Evolve Omega Lux experience. Build and run a revenue-generating conversion event using the complete Evolve Omega system. Your ultimate launchpad.
howToEarn: Top of the ladder. Olympian unlock = nearly mythical. The reward isn't the partnership itself — it's the conversation about whether Lux makes sense. Personal, by Danno. 1 per quarter cap. The mountain top of the gamification system.
